Our PhD & MSc Researchers
Postgraduate Research
The UCD School of Earth Sciences has a thriving international postgraduate community. We currently have around 20 students representing 8 nationalities. The majority of our postgraduates study for a PhD or MSc by research. Please see the UCD Graduate Studies page for more information on fees, funding and scholarships.
General information about postgraduate studies at UCD can be found on the UCD Graduate Studies Website.
